description_en: Iche Bāhāḥ, a branch of Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra (Oku Bāhāḥ,LAL2260),is located on the route from Mahābuddha to Thāpāhiti. Thebāhāḥis built on the southern wing of the courtyard. A photograph published inLocke(1985, 116) shows that thebāhāḥonce had a three-storey building. However, the sanctum is now on the ground floor of a newly reconstructed five-storey RCC building.Thephalcāat the front entrance was demolished due to the 2015 earthquake, meaning that thebāhāḥcan be seen from the street. Upon entering, one can find a statue of Mahākala supported by metal shoring to the left of the destroyedphalcā. The main monument building has been reconstructed and is now a five-story RCC building. The first floor is separated from the ground floor by a band of original timber cornice, but the upper floors are made of concrete, and the principal façade is constructed in modern, machine-manufactured bricks. The upper floors are furnished with large casement windows and used as residential apartments.The main sanctum is on the ground floor with a carved main entry wooden door flanked by two small windows on either sides. The entrance is guarded by two stone lions and has atoraṇafixed above it, depicting Akṣobhya at its centre and Prajñāpāramitā and Lokeśvara to his right and left respectively. Inside the sanctum, one can find a statue of Akṣobhya made from black stone. This statue is the monastic building'skvāḥpāḥdyāḥ. Alongside the statue, the sanctum also contains images of Lokeśvara, Vasundharā, Mahākāla and Acalavīra (Śākya1994, 111). A stone inscription dated NS 1006 (1886 CE) has been attached to the western wall of the sanctum. However, nothing is known about the establishment of thisbāhāḥ.The courtyard measures 12.5 m x 12.5 m and contains a centrally aligneddharmadhātu maṇḍala(80 cm high) and aśikharakūṭa caitya(195 cm high). Both of these can be found in front of the sanctum. The courtyard is paved inteliyātiles.
description_ne: यो रुद्रवर्ण महाविहारको शाखा विहार हो । ओकुबाहा:बाट पश्चिमपट्टि थपाहिटी जाँदा बाटोको दक्षिणमा यो विहार अवस्थित छ । पहिले यो विहार तीन तला थियो जसमा जस्तापाताको छाना राखिएको थियो (Locke1985, 115)।अहिले पाँच तल्लाको आधुनिक भवन बनाइएको छ । भुइँतल्ला चाहिँ विहारको लागि छोडिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकाको माथि काठकोतोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको मध्य भागमा अक्षोभ्य, दायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँ लोकेश्वर राखिएको छ ।गर्भगृहभित्र उत्तराभिमुख गरी कालो ढुंगाबाट निर्मित अक्षोभ्य बुद्धलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ ।गर्भगृहभित्र ११ शिर भएका लोकेश्वर, वसुन्धरा, महाकाल र अचलवीरका मूर्तिहरू सुरक्षित छ्न् (Śākya1994, 111)।गर्भगृहको पश्चिमतिर भित्तामा नेसं १००६ (सन् १८८६) को शिलापत्र राखिएको छ । विहारको सुरक्षार्थ सिंढीमा एक जोडी सिंह राखिएको छ ।विहार प्राङ्गणमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल र एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य रहेका छन् । शिखरकूट चैत्यको उत्तरमा इनार रहेको छ । यो विहार कहिले बनेको भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण भेटिएको छैन ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: Bikhā Siṃha, his wife Thakuṃ Mati, and his two sons Ratna Rāja and Caite Rāja established the stone image of Akṣobhyaafter the previous one was lost.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a pair of lions
historical_events.event_description: Caityarāja donated a pair of lion statues. However, the date could not be read from the inscription. The date given relies uponLocke(1985, 115).
